name: a live attempt on the same rail refuses the create with one agreed string

body.message: An unpaid checkout for this payment method is already in progress for this reference.

note: One payer-facing string per situation. The single-live refusal is worded here; the multi-live case (a repository exposing two live attempts for one rail) uses the separate 'multiple unpaid checkouts in progress' wording. Both are phrased with `reference`, never `order`, and the internal live/supersede vocabulary never reaches the payer.
